purpose: 10 proposed architectural sizes, not trained checkpoints or hardware selection

assumptions.baseline: one Engram module, four-stream GR, all decoder FFNs are MoE; two consecutive full layers share one KV owner
assumptions.ngram_rows: eight distinct nearby primes; capacity proposal, not an optimized collision policy
assumptions.active_convention: all non-routed neural matrices including tied full vocab head + selected experts + fetched table scalars
assumptions.mixed_weight_format: 4-bit routed experts; all other neural and table weights BF16
assumptions.full_training_state: BF16 weights and gradients, FP32 master weights and Adam moments: 16 bytes per parameter
assumptions.table_residency: GPU/RAM/shards undecided; offload does not remove total stored bytes
exclusions: edit metadata, token-prefix buffer and GPU table cache
activations beyond one illustrative live GR buffer
logits, kernel workspace, dispatch, communication and allocator memory

engram.fusion: branch-specific keys/gates and shared value before mixer

estimate.status: analytical, excludes small service parameters; no trained model or measured VRAM
